title: Igor Lutts
content: Igor has extensive experience in marketing, media, and venture capital projects. Igor headed the international advertising Agency BBDO for 15 years. under his leadership, the company increased its staff from 7 to 700 people and began to provide a full range of services (media promotion, strategic and brand consulting, design, PR). Igor has long been a partner of the Untitled venture Fund, which invests in technology companies around the world.

title: Michael Ward
content: Career investment banker with over 30 years experience at the Royal Bank of Scotland plc (Global Sector Lead for Automotive) and Nomura Group (Head of European Automotive Sector Advisory). Advised governments and corporations throughout the emerging and mature economies of Europe, Asia and the US. Most recently provides independent corporate finance, M&A and strategic advisory services to top European clients through Ward Corporate Finance Ltd. focusing on the automotive sector. Non-executive director at Piech Automotive AG, WheelRight Ltd and Open Energy Market Ltd.

title: Kong Chee Keong
content:
Kong is an investment banker with over 30 years of M&A advisory, capital markets and fundraising experience in Asia. Based in Singapore Kong has held senior roles in Japanese industrial companies, Temasek linked companies and Nomura where he was Head of IB South East Asia. At present Kong is the Managing Partner at Athena Advisors Ltd. advising large multinational Chinese, Korean and Japanese clients on M&A, ECM and DCM 
Kong is fluent in Japanese and Mandarin.

title: Stephen Price
content: Stephen has more than 40 years of experience in the financial advisory sector. His career includes projects for the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development. Prior to establishing the RB Partners Group, Stephen was a Senior Partner at EY (UK). In the mid 90s, while at EY, he organized an international group providing corporate finance services to financial institutions operating in the emerging markets. Stephen graduated with honours from Leeds University (UK).
